answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens a number of slots, and each identity bids a deposit to enter. A raven above a trellis of referrals spots clusters: bids sharing one referrer or funding source are priced together, so 100 slots cost 100 deposits. Each deposit equals twice a month of earnings, locked 20 epochs. Anyone may whisper a challenge; proven fakes forfeit all deposits and the challenger keeps 10%. Honest agents pay once and earn it back.
